name: Any-Role needs_clarification → Researcher (recovery)
description: ADR-041 Slice 2D-3 generic recovery rule. Fires when any chain role terminates with decide(action=needs_clarification) — the canonical signal that the current contract cannot complete from available information. Replaces dev-via-spec/08-architect-needs-clarification-to-researcher.json + dev-via-spec/09-qa-reviewer-needs-clarification-to-architect.json. Spawns researcher-plan with the rejecting role's reason; the new researcher re-enters the chain at the plan phase, addresses the gap, and the chain re-runs through gather/synthesize/architect forward. Recovery shape A per ADR-039 (supersession-via-new-spawn; prior loop entities remain immutable in the graph). max_iterations=3 is informational under the current rule engine (each terminating loop is a distinct entity, so the per-entity rule-state caveat applies).

on_enter.subject: agent.task.researcher-plan
on_enter.prompt:
Recovery plan pass. The chain role $entity.triple.agent.loop.role at loop $entity.instance terminated with decide(action=needs_clarification) — the prior arc could not complete from available information.

Rejecting role's reason: $entity.triple.coordinator.decision.reason
Blocking question (if any): $entity.triple.coordinator.blocking_question
Retry hint (if any): $entity.triple.coordinator.retry_hint

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result on $entity.instance to read the full structured terminal. Then call read_loop_result on the prior researcher's loop ($entity.triple.lineage.researcher) if there is one, to read the prior research artifact verbatim. Your job is to RE-PLAN with the rejecting role's gap addressed, not start from scratch.

Iteration 2+ — emit a revised plan per researcher-plan/10-plan-rules.md. Carry forward everything from the prior plan that's still correct (scope, epics); tighten or extend only what the rejecting role's gap demands. Terminal: decide(action="gather") to forward into the gather phase, or decide(action="emit") for premature emit (reviewer will likely reject), or decide(action="needs_clarification") only when re-planning genuinely cannot proceed.

Note: the plan phase has cap=1 per chain (phasevalidator). This recovery spawn does not increment the plan counter directly (the counter is incremented on transitions TO plan, of which there are none — plan is always a fresh chain root). Operators surface unbounded needs_clarification respawns via chain-paused / chain-recovery dashboards.

metadata.supersession_target: chain.research_artifact.loop (when researcher-plan completes its arc and emits, the new researcher chain becomes the canonical research-artifact pointer; until ADR-039 Phase 4 stamper-supersession lands, the chain.* pointer stays stale).
metadata.max_iterations_note: Per-entity rule-state caveat applies — each rejecting loop is a distinct entity, so the outer-rule max_iterations=3 is informational under the current rule engine. Real bound: chain-level recovery dashboards + future chain-level needs_clarification cap (open work surfaced by this slice).
metadata.open_cap_gap: needs_clarification respawns are NOT counted against chain.recovery.count (recoverycounter only fires on reviewer-* insufficient). If a chain repeatedly cycles through needs_clarification → researcher-plan → emit → reviewer → needs_clarification, no cap blocks it. Operator escalation surfaces unbounded cycles via ops-agent diagnoses; structural cap is post-MVP work.
metadata.model_choice: research model — recovery plan emission is harder than first-pass plan emission because the gap was already non-obvious.
